name: CodeRabbit
category: Code review, testing, docs and security
product: AI pull-request reviewer that comments on PRs in GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket and Azure DevOps, plus IDE and CLI reviews.
free_tier: Yes (free for open source / public repos; 14-day trial with no card)
starting_paid_price: $24/developer/month billed annually ($30 month-to-month), Essentials plan
latest_funding: Reported $143M round at $1.5B valuation (TechFundingNews, 2026); prior $60M Series B Sept 2025 led by Scale Venture Partners
founders_or_ceo: Harjot Gill (CEO, co-founder); Gur Singh (COO, co-founder)
africa_evidence: No evidence found in searches. Billing docs show self-serve checkout in USD or INR only (local-currency billing exists for India, not for any African country).
payment_methods: Credit card or invoice; payment currency USD or INR (INR limited to Essentials/Team)
africa_use_case: Lagos and Nairobi startups and outsourced dev agencies could pay per developer to get automatic PR reviews on client repos without adding senior reviewers.
notes: Strong self-serve per-seat plan with card checkout and an existing local-currency option for India, which shows willingness to localise billing. Has a Startup Program. Billing source: https://docs.coderabbit.ai/management/billing

name: Greptile
category: Code review, testing, docs and security
product: AI code review agent that indexes the whole repository as a graph and reviews pull requests on GitHub and GitLab.
free_tier: Yes (Starter free for 1 developer with 50 credits/month; open-source programme and startup grant listed)
starting_paid_price: $1 per credit on Pro, no seat fees (earlier 2026 model was $30/seat for 50 reviews)
latest_funding: $50M Series B led by Menlo Ventures at $750M valuation, October 2026
founders_or_ceo: Daksh Gupta (CEO, co-founder); Soohoon Choi; Vaishant Kameswaran
payment_methods: Prepaid credits; checkout method not stated in sources found
africa_use_case: Small Nairobi or Accra product teams could buy prepaid review credits in small top-ups instead of committing to per-seat plans.
notes: Prepaid credit model suits wallet-style top-ups. Series B source: https://www.greptile.com/blog/series-b

name: Graphite
category: Code review, testing, docs and security
company: Screenplay Studios Inc. (Graphite), owned by Anysphere (Cursor)
product: Code review platform with stacked pull requests, merge queue and the Graphite Agent AI reviewer for GitHub.
free_tier: Yes (Hobby tier for personal repos with limited AI reviews)
starting_paid_price: $20/user/month billed annually (Starter); Team $40/seat/month annually
latest_funding: Acquired by Anysphere (Cursor), announced 19 Dec 2025; previously $52M Series B led by Accel, March 2025
founders_or_ceo: Merrill Lutsky (CEO, co-founder); Tomas Reimers; Greg Foster
payment_methods: Credit card only for Starter and Team plans, billed via Stripe
africa_use_case: Fintech engineering teams in Lagos that ship many small dependent changes could use stacked PRs and AI review to speed up merges.
notes: Kept despite acquisition: Graphite says it continues as an independent product under Cursor. GitHub-only. Card-only checkout is a direct Cozzipay pitch angle. Payment source: https://graphite.com/docs/pricing-faq

name: Qodo
category: Code review, testing, docs and security
product: AI code review and governance platform with agentic PR review, rules system, IDE integrations and test generation; open-source PR-Agent.
free_tier: Yes (14-day free trial with no card; open-source PR-Agent can be self-hosted free)
starting_paid_price: $30/month Pro Team credit pack (pooled credits, monthly, no commitment)
latest_funding: $70M Series B led by Qumra Capital, 30 March 2026 (total $120M)
africa_use_case: South African and Kenyan enterprise IT teams and agencies could enforce coding standards across client repos with Qodo's rules and PR review.
notes: Self-serve credit packs designed for up to 30 users; Enterprise is sales-led. Funding source: https://techcrunch.com/2026/03/30/qodo-bets-on-code-verification-as-ai-coding-scales-raises-70m/

name: Sourcery
category: Code review, testing, docs and security
product: AI code reviewer for GitHub and GitLab that gives line-by-line PR feedback and IDE suggestions.
free_tier: Yes (free for open source)
starting_paid_price: $12/seat/month billed annually ($15 monthly), Pro plan
latest_funding: Seed, $1.75M led by Forward Partners, January 2022
founders_or_ceo: Brendan Maginnis and Nick Thapen (co-founders); Tim Gilboy (co-founder)
payment_methods: Card by default; wire transfer or invoice billing on request via billing@sourcery.ai
africa_use_case: Freelance developers and small dev shops in Lagos or Kampala could afford one of the cheapest per-seat AI reviewers on the market.
notes: Low price point fits African budgets. Billing source: https://docs.sourcery.ai/Getting-Started/Managing-Teams-and-Accounts/Managing-Billing/

name: Codacy
category: Code review, testing, docs and security
product: Code quality and security platform with AI reviewer, SAST, SCA, secrets detection, coverage and merge gates for GitHub, GitLab and Bitbucket.
free_tier: Yes (Developer plan free for individuals; free for qualifying open source)
starting_paid_price: $18/developer/month billed yearly ($21 monthly), Team plan
latest_funding: $15.4M Series B, September 2022 (total about $29.9M)
founders_or_ceo: Jaime Jorge (CEO, co-founder); João Caxaria (CTO, co-founder)
africa_use_case: Lusophone African dev teams (Angola, Mozambique) and Lagos agencies could use Codacy for quality gates and security scanning on client codebases.
notes: Company facts from Codacy's own AI info page: https://try.codacy.com/ai-info. Portuguese HQ could ease outreach to Lusophone Africa.

name: DeepSource
category: Code review, testing, docs and security
product: AI code review and static analysis platform with Autofix AI and security scanning.
free_tier: Yes (free for open source; 14-day trial with no card)
starting_paid_price: $24-30/contributor/month, Team plan (sources differ: $24 annual per third party, $30 per DeepSource docs)
latest_funding: Acquired by Harness, announced 9 Sept 2026
payment_methods: Not found (monthly and annual billing cycles available)
africa_use_case: Nairobi SaaS startups could use committer-based billing so they pay only for developers who actually push code.
notes: Kept because DeepSource says workspaces keep working and the product stays on sale after the Harness deal, but it will be folded into the Harness platform over time, so the pitch may need to go to Harness. Source: https://deepsource.com/blog/deepsource-joins-harness

name: Snyk Code
category: Code review, testing, docs and security
hq_country: United States / United Kingdom (Boston and London; Israeli-founded)
product: AI-native SAST (Snyk Code) within Snyk's developer security platform, also covering open source, containers and IaC.
free_tier: Yes (Free plan with limited Snyk Code tests)
starting_paid_price: $25/contributing developer/month, Team plan (minimum 5, maximum 10 developers)
latest_funding: $196.5M Series G at $7.4B valuation, December 2022
founders_or_ceo: Peter McKay (CEO; announced Feb 2026 he will step down once a successor is found); founder Guy Podjarny
africa_evidence: No evidence found in searches. Snyk runs a global channel partner programme, but no African reseller or distributor appeared in the sources found.
africa_use_case: South African banks' digital teams and Lagos fintechs facing compliance audits could adopt Snyk Code for SAST in CI.
notes: Team plan is self-serve but capped at 10 developers; larger buyers are pushed into enterprise credit contracts. Partner programme: https://partners.snyk.io/

name: Ellipsis
category: Code review, testing, docs and security
product: Started as an AI PR reviewer and bug fixer; since mid-2026 it is a managed cloud platform for running coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini) that still offers AI code review.
free_tier: Not found (earlier: 7-day free trial)
starting_paid_price: Usage-based: agent tokens plus 10%, plus compute per CPU-hour and GiB-hour; no per-seat fees
latest_funding: Seed, $2M, 2024 (YC W24)
africa_use_case: Kigali or Lagos dev agencies running coding agents for many clients could cap per-project agent budgets on Ellipsis.
notes: Product pivoted from code review to agent cloud (per tomrochette.com, July 2026); code review still listed at https://www.ellipsis.dev/features/code-review

name: CodeAnt AI
category: Code review, testing, docs and security
product: AI code review, code quality and code security platform, now also selling AI pentesting.
free_tier: Not found
starting_paid_price: $24/user/month for AI Code Review per mlq.ai (Nov 2026); earlier reported from $10/developer/month
latest_funding: Seed, $2M at $20M valuation, May 2025 (YC, Uncorrelated Ventures, VitalStage)
founders_or_ceo: Amartya Jha (CEO, co-founder); Chinmay Bharti (CTO, co-founder)
africa_use_case: Lagos fintech startups preparing for bank or regulator security reviews could combine PR review and security scanning in one tool.
notes: Pricing figures vary across third-party sources; official pricing page not confirmed. Funding: https://www.securityweek.com/codeant-ai-raises-2-million-for-code-quality-and-application-security-platform/

name: Mintlify
category: Code review, testing, docs and security
product: AI-native developer documentation platform with AI assistant, agent-readable docs and auto-updated content.
free_tier: Yes (free plan with up to 5 editors)
starting_paid_price: $150/month billed annually (new Starter plan per pricingsaas, Nov 2026); Pro $450/month billed annually
latest_funding: $45M Series B co-led by Andreessen Horowitz and Salesforce Ventures at $500M valuation, April 2026
africa_use_case: African fintech and payments API companies in Lagos and Nairobi could publish developer docs that both humans and AI agents read.
notes: Flat team pricing rather than per seat; strong fit for API-first African fintechs, but the jump from free to paid is steep. Funding: https://www.mintlify.com/blog/series-b

name: Swimm
category: Code review, testing, docs and security
product: AI application-understanding and modernisation service that maps dependencies and generates documentation for legacy and mainframe codebases.
free_tier: No
starting_paid_price: Not found (no public pricing; priced by lines of code via demo/assessment)
latest_funding: $27.6M Series A led by Insight Partners, November 2021
founders_or_ceo: Oren Toledano (CEO, co-founder); Omer Rosenbaum (CTO, co-founder)
africa_use_case: Large African banks and telcos with COBOL or legacy core systems could use Swimm to document code before modernisation projects.
notes: Swimm announced in 2026 it is becoming a service company; enterprise sales only, so wallet checkout is unlikely to matter. Source: https://swimm.io/blog/weve-stopped-asking-customers-to-bet-on-the-right-tool

name: Diffblue
category: Code review, testing, docs and security
product: Diffblue Cover autonomously writes and maintains Java and Kotlin unit tests using reinforcement learning.
free_tier: Yes (Community Edition IntelliJ plugin, free for life)
starting_paid_price: Not found (Teams and Enterprise prices not listed)
latest_funding: $6.3M round anchored by IP Group, Parkwalk and AlbionVC, October 2024; £1M Innovate UK grant 2025
africa_use_case: Java-heavy engineering teams at South African and Nigerian banks could raise unit-test coverage on legacy Spring services.
notes: Paid editions are contact-sales; Java/Kotlin only.

name: TestSprite
category: Code review, testing, docs and security
product: AI testing agent that writes, runs and maintains end-to-end frontend and backend tests from plain-language specs or PRDs, including on pull requests.
free_tier: Yes (free plan / free testing on a live app)
starting_paid_price: $69/month Pro (1,600 credits); team plans $199+/month from 10 seats
africa_use_case: Early-stage Nairobi and Lagos startups without QA engineers, including vibe-coding founders, could get automated E2E testing for a monthly fee.
notes: Pro price from TestSprite's own pricing blog: https://www.testsprite.com/ja/blog/testsprite-pricing-which-plan-fits-a-solo-developer

name: Momentic
category: Code review, testing, docs and security
product: AI-native QA platform where tests are written in plain English and AI agents run and self-heal them across web, iOS and Android.
free_tier: Yes ($50 of free usage each month, no card)
starting_paid_price: $500/month Scale plan (usage-based balance, no per-seat fees)
latest_funding: $15M Series A led by Standard Capital, 24 Nov 2025 (total about $18.7M)
africa_use_case: Mobile-first African consumer apps and fintechs could test SMS/OTP sign-up and payment flows on hosted Android emulators.
notes: Prepaid top-ups from $50 map well to wallet payments; jump from free to $500/month is large.

name: Meticulous
category: Code review, testing, docs and security
product: Automated frontend regression testing that records user sessions and replays them against code changes before merge, without hand-written tests.
free_tier: Not found
starting_paid_price: Not found on official page; extruct.ai (2024) listed Starter at $399/month for 40 PRs
latest_funding: $15M Series A led by Chemistry with Menlo Ventures, July 2026
africa_use_case: Large web frontends at African e-commerce firms such as Johannesburg or Lagos marketplaces could catch UI regressions without writing tests.
notes: Pricing likely sales-led; the only price found is old and third-party. Funding: https://sifted.eu/articles/ex-palantir-dropbox-elevenlabs-notion-wiz-ship-ai-generated-code

name: Keploy
category: Code review, testing, docs and security
hq_country: Not found (founded by Indian founders; HQ not confirmed in sources)
product: Open-source API and integration testing tool that turns real traffic into replayable tests and mocks for developers and coding agents.
free_tier: Yes (open-source self-hosted and free Playground with quotas)
starting_paid_price: $19/user/month plus usage, Pro plan
latest_funding: Not found
africa_evidence: No evidence found in searches. Keploy runs an online API Fellowship and an affiliate programme, but no source ties either to Africa.
africa_use_case: Backend teams building payment and mobile-money integrations in Nairobi or Lagos could record real API traffic to generate regression tests.
notes: Community-led growth (fellowship, OSS fund) could pair well with Cozzipay developer outreach. Fellowship: https://fellowship.keploy.io/

name: Checksum
category: Code review, testing, docs and security
hq_country: United States (founder Israeli; listed on Start-Up Nation Central)
product: Continuous quality platform whose AI agents generate, run and auto-heal Playwright E2E and API tests in CI.
free_tier: Not found on official page (third party stork.ai lists a free tier of 10 tests/month)
starting_paid_price: Not found on official page (priced by number of tests maintained, no per-seat fees); stork.ai lists Pro at $49/month
latest_funding: Seed (amount not found)
africa_use_case: Growth-stage African SaaS companies could hand off E2E test upkeep instead of hiring a QA team.
notes: Appears sales-led; third-party price points unconfirmed.

name: Corgea
category: Code review, testing, docs and security
product: AI-native application security platform with AI SAST, dependency, secrets, container and IaC scanning, auto-fixes and AI pentesting.
free_tier: Yes (up to 2 team members and 10 repos, no card)
starting_paid_price: $39/developer/month, Growth plan (minimum 5 developers)
latest_funding: Seed, $2.6M led by Shorooq Partners, November 2024 (YC)
africa_evidence: No evidence found in searches. Corgea has a Middle East focus (Gulf-based lead investor), but no source mentions Africa.
africa_use_case: North African and Nigerian fintechs could use auto-fix SAST to close vulnerabilities before PCI or central-bank audits.
notes: MENA angle via Shorooq could make North Africa (Egypt, Morocco) a natural next market. Source: https://www.thenationalnews.com/future/technology/2024/11/25/how-corgea-is-leveraging-ai-to-redefine-cyber-security-in-the-middle-east/

name: Aikido Security
category: Code review, testing, docs and security
product: Developer-first security platform covering SAST and AI SAST, SCA, secrets, cloud posture, containers, DAST and AI autofixes.
free_tier: Yes (Developer plan free forever, 2 users, no card)
starting_paid_price: $300/month flat (Basic, includes 10 users) per aikido.dev and third parties; G2/Capterra list from $350/month
latest_funding: $60M Series B at $1B valuation led by DST Global, 14 Jan 2026
africa_evidence: SecuriCentrix, an independent consultancy, says it implements and operates Aikido for clients in South Africa and Zimbabwe, but describes Aikido as a third-party platform, so this is not an official reseller or partnership.
payment_methods: Not found (pricing page notes prices exclude local taxes)
africa_use_case: Seed-stage African fintechs could get SOC 2-style code-to-cloud security coverage for a flat monthly fee covering the whole small team.
notes: Closest to an African footprint in this batch via a managed-service consultancy; worth checking whether Aikido has a formal partner programme that SecuriCentrix could join.

name: Bito
category: Code review, testing, docs and security
product: AI Code Review Agent for GitHub, GitLab and Bitbucket plus IDE and CLI, with an AI Architect context engine for coding agents.
free_tier: Yes (free plan)
starting_paid_price: $12/seat/month billed annually ($15 monthly), Team plan
latest_funding: $5.7M seed extension led by Vela Partners, May 2025 (total seed $8.8M)
founders_or_ceo: Amar Goel (CEO, co-founder); Anand Das (CTO); Mukesh Agarwal
africa_use_case: Price-sensitive dev agencies in Lagos, Accra and Nairobi could add AI review on every client repo at one of the lowest seat prices available.
notes: SWAP: replaces Korbit AI, which Boost Security acquired in May 2026; Korbit's get-started page returned 404 and its pricing page points to Boost (https://boostsecurity.io/blog/announcing-two-acquisitions-and-a-funding-round).

name: Semgrep
category: Code review, testing, docs and security
product: Code security platform (SAST, supply chain, secrets) with Semgrep Assistant AI triage and autofix.
free_tier: Yes (Code and Supply Chain free for organisations with 10 or fewer monthly contributors; open-source CE)
starting_paid_price: $30-35/contributor/month for Code or Supply Chain on Teams (sources differ); Secrets $15/contributor/month
latest_funding: $100M Series D led by Menlo Ventures, February 2025 (total $204M)
africa_use_case: African startups can start free and convert to paid once they pass 10 contributors, a natural moment to offer wallet checkout.
notes: SWAP: replaces Octomind, which shut down in 2026 (farewell letter 23 April, service ended end of May; site no longer resolves): https://rywalker.com/research/octomind
